digest.component_or_area: fetcher enrichment handlers and Cloud adapter boundary
propositions: RunawayPaginationError subclasses RuntimeError instead of BackendPaginationStallError, placing it outside the core stall type hierarchy
fetch_snapshot's three enrichment re-raise clauses match only on BackendPaginationStallError, causing Cloud stalls to miss those handlers and fall through to the broad except Exception fail-opens
A stalled Cloud pagination cursor produces a silently degraded snapshot with missing parents and issuelinks instead of propagating the error and aborting the pass

The fix changes RunawayPaginationError to subclass BackendPaginationStallError while preserving RuntimeError in its MRO, allowing the three fetcher re-raise clauses to catch and propagate Cloud stalls
Existing except RunawayPaginationError and except RuntimeError call sites remain unaffected by the fix because the error class name does not change and RuntimeError stays in the inheritance chain
